question: What kind of recipient, tested over what duration, is fit to receive a teaching that has been previously accomplished?
premises: Only a previously accomplished person is a candidate for this gift.
Fitness for this teaching must be established by testing.
A test lasting one year is the prescribed measure of that fitness.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The precise criteria of the year-long test are not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
